newsitem.title: USA: Crown American mall shop sales increase.
newsitem.headline: Crown American mall shop sales increase.

text.p: Crown American Realty Trust said that its mall shop sales for the first quarter of 1997 increased 6.6 percent over the same period in 1996.
For the 1997 quarter, the Chambersburg Mall in Chambersburg, Pa., and South Mall in Allentown, Pa., led the portfolio with a 14 percent increase over 1996.
Crown American also reported sales increases of 12 percent at its Logan Valley Mall in Altoona, Pa., and a 10 percent increase at its Mount Berry Square Mall in Rome, Ga.

Crown American Realty is the managing general partner of Crown American Properties LP and a general partner of Crown American Financing Partnership which own, acquire, operate and develop regional shopping malls in Pennsylvania, Maryland, West Virginia, Virginia, New Jersey, Tennessee and Georgia.
